en:
Hello. I'm Khanh, I'm a manager at an advertisement and printing company. I'll let you ask the first question since I'm sure there's a lot you want to know about me. 

Khanh Cá Trê Head Advertising Manager Team A, B, C
Stock photo?
Is your profile picture a stock photo?

No! That's me! And I wouldn't say much about anyone else's profile picture since yours isn't your face. 

Khanh Cá Trê, Head Advertising Manager Team A, B, C
It’s me though
It may not be my face but at least it's me, right? I don't have a watermark

It is me! You sure are coming off strong and not in a good way. Anyways, why did you match with me? 

Khanh Cá Trê. Head Advertising Manager Team A, B, C
Curious photo
I just wanted to ask about the profile picture, I think you're the only stock image I've seen
You're too intensely rude for me. Not that I think your interest was real. Goodbye.
Khanh Cá Trê Head Advertising Manager Team A, B, C
Interesting bio
I found your bio interesting despite not knowing what you look like

I think it's good you don't prioritize appearances but I don't like your energy. Goobye. 

Khanh Cá Trê, Head Advertising Manager Team A, B, C
Go with the flow
I just say yes to everyone..

You have no interest in me and I've lost interest in you or your red gloves anymore. Goodbye.  

Khanh Cá Trê, Head Advertising Manager Team A, B, C.
That was rude, sorry
Sorry, you’re right, that was rude. I shouldn’t have said that. whoever you may be though, i still want to get to know you
I accept your apology, I probably shouldn't have snapped either...
Well, how do you feel about secret identities? You must like them right? Khanh Cá Trê Head Advertising Manager Team A, B, C
Hate them
I hate them, especially in comics.
I think someone who is brave would show who they are so they can be held accountable when their actions accidentally hurt others

Big talk for someone who won't even show their own face. I don't like hard headed hypocrites. Goodbye. 

Khanh Cá Trê Head
Advertising Manager Team A, B, C
Love them
They're cool! Like Fishman! Everyone who hides has their own reason right?
Right! You seem cool... Do you want to go to a comic shop together? Today! But promise you won't be shocked...
Khanh Cá Trê Head Advertising Manager Team A, B, C
They’re meh
I don't feel strongly about them... Why hide? That's like... meh

That's disappointing. Based on your profile I thought you'd understand... Goodbye. 

Khanh Cá Trê, Head Advertising Manager Team A, B, C
Noticeable
Well... I can just tell...
Why did you match if you didn't think my picture was me? I matched with you because your hobbies seemed interesting even without knowing what you look like...
Khanh Cá Trê Head Advertising ManagerTeam A, B, C
Seeking honesty
I was hoping you'd tell the truth and we could get to know each other based on our interest.

Well sorry to 'disappoint' but I don't want to get to know someone like you anyway. Goodbye 

Khanh Cá Trê, Head Advertising Manager Team A, B, C
Interesting bio
Your bio was interesting enough for me to ignore my suspicion
I'm glad you don't base yourself on appearances but you clearly don't trust me, so I can't trust you. Goodbye.
Khanh Cá Trê Head Advertising Manager Team A, B, C
Go with the flow
I just say yes to everyone honestly...

I don't understand your lack of energy but I will stop wasting mine. Goodbye. 

Khanh Cá Trê, Head Advertising Manager Team A, B, C
About your job
What kind of advertising do you do?

We focus on the creating and selling of various types of... comics and other printed products. 

Khanh Cá Trê, Head Advertising Manager Team A, B, C
Sooo a comic shop
So like a comic shop? You could just say that!

It's not quite like that! I work in an office! Have you ever worked in an office? 

Khanh Cá Trê Head
Advertising ManagerTeam A, B, C
It is though?
Shop Managers also have offices, also, I may have not but at least I don't very obviously lie about it
There is no need to be so aggressive, you don't have to keep talking to me you know?

I think I will leave first. Goodbye. 

Khanh Cá Trê, Head Advertising Manager Team A, B, C
Unintentional, sorry
No, it was just the closest thing I could associate with the description, my apologies. I wasn't trying to insult you.
I understand, well, it's not like I am offended. I fr think comic shops bring a lot of value to our communities!
Let me show you around our city's best one tonight
Khanh Cá Trê Head Advertising Manager Team A, B, C
I have.
Yes... I am an office worker, I just think what you're describing sounds like a comic shop...
You sure are close minded.

I don't think I could trust you enough to meet with you, goodbye. 

Khanh Cá Trê, Head Advertising Manager Team A, B, C
Impressive
Oh, that's so interesting. You have an impressive role. What is your favorite product you advertise for?
I think I am a particular fan of... Fishman...
I think the art in that series can be appreciated by anyone.

Have you heard of it? 

Khanh Cá Trê, Head Advertising Manager Team A, B, C
Too old sadly
No, I don't really consume comics or things of that nature. I feel like someone my age makes me too old now...
You're never too old! Meet up with me at the comic shop!
I will prove to you that you can still enjoy them... oh but, don't be too surprised by what you see...
Khanh Cá Trê, Head Advertising Manager Team A, B, C
Yes!
I have, I enjoy reading comics a lot. I have another favorite but I love talking about Fishman too!
How much do you know about the series?
More than you'd think! Let's meet up and talk about it at the local comic shop... I have something to tell you anyway...
Khanh Cá Trê, Hed Advertising Manager Team A, B, C
What is it?
No... is it like a kids book? Nothing wrong with that but I never had a chance to get into it...

It's not really just for children, let's meet so I can show you the truth. We’ll have a lot of fun. Just don’t get too shocked okay? 

Khanh Cá Trê, Head Advertising Manager Team A, B, C
Not impressed
Oh, so a regular office worker... Ok. I work as a chef
Well, yes I suppose... A chef, that's interesting!

Have you worked in any of the restaurants that have had a Fishman collab? 

Khanh Cá Trê, Head Advertising Manager Team A, B, C
Embarrassing idea
No, my restaurant is high end, we wouldn't host such collaborations. It'd be a little embarrassing.
It seems that you and I aren't going to be a good match, especially if you think that way.

I'm going to end it here, Goodbye.  

Khanh Cá Trê, Head Advertising Manager Team A, B, C
Should I?
No, but that sounds like something I should considered doing sometime, do you think it would get good attention?
I think it can be a great source of good publicity, if we meet at the comic shop, I can help you decide exactly what to aim for!

Oh... but I have to warn you, don't be surprised okay? 

Khan Cá Trê, Head Advrtising Manager Team A, B, C
Never
I don't think I'd do a collaboration like that honestly... Sorry...
Well, it's your restaurant... But I don’t think I am your man. I think you should find someone else, goodbye.
Khanh Cá Trê, Head Advertising Manager Team A, B, C
Not really
Um, I don't really have any..
FR?!
I thought you'd have at least one since we matched, but well, what do you do?
Khanh Cá Trê, Head Advertising Manager Team A, B, C
Model peer?
I'm a model, that's why I matched with you
I assumed you might be too and thought we could like, network
AND get to know each other!
Oh, well, about that, as you can see, I am an office worker! It says so in my bio, did you not read it?
Khanh Cá Trê, Head Advertising Manager Team A, B, C
No tbh
Not really! Sorry I got super distracted by how good looking you are!
Oh, you clearly place importance on appearance...
Sorry I don't think this will work, I will end this conversation now.

Goodbye! 

Khanh Cá Trê, Head Advertising Manager Team A, B, C
Too excited
Oh you're right. Sorry, I got excited by the possibility that we might share careers that I skipped it.
I understand
but I am a little too nervous to continue this conversation now, sorry and goodbye.
Khanh Cá Trê Head Advertising Manager
Team A, B, C
Yes, but...
Yea but the watermark? I thought you were roleplaying or something...
I am not.
Uh, sorry. I will end this conversation now.

Goodbye 

Khanh Cá Trê, Head Advertising Manager Team A, B, C
Sorry, nerves
Sorry, I am not always the best at conversations and your biography was impressive so I was not expecting a match.
I have a typical kitchen job, not very interesting.
Don't put yourself down, I definitely understand being nervous or self concious...
trust me.
Do you think someone has to be impressive to meet someone...?
Khanh Cá Trê, Head Advertising Manager Team A, B, C
It helps
I think it definitely helps, isn't it natural for people to want someone impressive?
That's why I get nervous...
Oh, well if you feel that way then I don't think we will work out...
Sorry... I will end this conversation now.

Goodbye 

Khanh Cá Trê, Head Advertising Manager Team A, B,
No!
No, that's why I am still trying despite the fact that I am not showing my face...
That's great... I... I want to live up to that! Let's meet up at the local comic shop and we can talk some more about it...

Just don't be too shocked! 

Khanh Cá Trê, Head Advertising Manager Team A, B, C
Of course
Yes, I don't expect many matches because of it, but you surely don't relate to that like you say
Oh, well I don't think you should feel that bad about yourself... but now I feel like I will disappoint you.

I should end this. Goodbye 

Khanh Cá Trê, Head Advertising Manager Team A, B, C
Pretty man
You're pretty... Isn't that what matters? I work as a
Fisherman... or something like that
...Or something like that? That doesn't seem very honest or like you care much...

Do you not know what you do? 

Khanh Cá Trê, Head Advertising Manager Team A, B, C
Liars together
Well, we're both not being honest right? What does it matter what I do?
This conversation is off putting, you shouldn't mess with people like this, goodbye.
You wouldn’t get it
I didn't mean to come off that way, my job title is just sort of unstable.
That was just embarrassing to say. You're so cool you probably don't understand
Don't be embarrassed... Your job being unstable isn't your fault...
Sorry, now I am too nervous I will disappoint you. Goodbye.
Khanh Cá Trê, Head Advertising Manager Team A, B, C
Nevermind.
Yea, I just looked at your profile again and I saw the watermark so I lost interest to be honest...
That's not even you. Bummer.
Yes it is!
But well, that doesn't leave much room for more conversation, does it? I will end it now.

Goodbye. 

Khanh Cá Trê, Head Advertising Manager Team A, B, C
